format: Build a tight case study: type of company, the problem they had, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:

They switched to SmartPRO Hub in week one.

That morning routine is now 15 minutes.

Zero missed renewals in the first 90 days. The same PRO officer now carries a larger client load — no extra headcount needed.
